business_objective: Convert received paper records into indexed digital copies and archive only copies that pass readability review.

stakeholder_statements.text: The records intake clerk receives a paper record and records its source and document title.
The scanning operator creates a digital copy of the received paper record.
The indexing clerk assigns a document type and a reference label to the digital copy.
The quality reviewer records the digital copy as readable or requiring another scan.
The archive custodian stores only a readable digital copy and closes the record after storage is confirmed. Editing document content and destroying paper originals are outside this project.

business_objective: Record volunteer service entries, verify completed service, and add approved entries to each volunteer's service record.

stakeholder_statements.text: A volunteer submits a service entry with the activity, service date, and claimed duration.
The team supervisor records the service entry as verified or disputed.
The volunteer may add a response note to a disputed service entry.
The program coordinator adds only verified service entries to the volunteer's service record.
The records lead closes the service period after every submitted entry is added or left disputed. Volunteer reimbursement and shift scheduling are outside this project.

business_objective: Route support requests requiring language assistance, prepare translated support content, and send translated responses to customers.

stakeholder_statements.text: A customer submits a support issue and states the preferred language for the response.
The intake agent marks the request as needing language assistance and routes it to the language coordinator. The supported-language list has not been agreed.
The language coordinator assigns a language specialist or records that assistance is unavailable. The assignment rule is still undecided.
The language specialist records a translated issue summary and the translated response text.
The resolution agent sends the translated response to the customer. The delivery channel is undecided, and billing adjustments are outside this project.

business_objective: Coordinate employee job-shadow requests through workload review, host-team acceptance, scheduling, and confidentiality acknowledgement.

stakeholder_statements.text: An employee submits a job-shadow request and identifies the target team and learning goal.
The line manager records whether the employee's workload permits participation. The criteria for making that decision have not been agreed.
The host team lead accepts or declines the request and identifies the host contact when it is accepted.
The program coordinator schedules an accepted shadow visit and sends the visit details to the employee. The delivery channel is undecided.
The employee records a confidentiality acknowledgement before the shadow visit. Performance evaluation and permanent team transfer are outside this project.

business_objective: Track session-recording authorization, edited recordings, rights notes, and publication decisions while preserving an unresolved final-approval rule.

stakeholder_statements.text: A session speaker submits presentation materials and records whether the session may be recorded.
The event coordinator records any speaker opt-out received before the event. The coordinator says the event registration terms authorize recording when no opt-out exists.
When recording authorization is present, the content producer records the session and creates an edited version.
The rights reviewer records rights notes and says the final edited version must be approved by the speaker before publication.

The publication lead records a publication decision after the rights notes are present and says the registration terms alone are sufficient, so speaker approval is not needed. Nobody has agreed how long recordings should be retained or who resolves the approval disagreement. The meeting ended with jokes about the stage lights.
